# ChunkEmpty

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

Every sample of the chunk is on the same side of the surface: nothing to mesh

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `mean` | `float` | mean density (> 0: solid, else air) |

## Notes

Written by ChunkGenerator.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ChunkGenerator](../systems/ChunkGenerator.md)**
  - Up to 16 taskflow silent_async jobs at a time (all pending chunks in deterministic runs), FastNoise2 on worker threads.

- **[TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in sorted cell order (deterministic).

  - Log warning 'Terrain collider : ...' when Jolt refuses a mesh.
